name: MAU Top Bar
author: maucoders

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mau-top-bar directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Customize the top bar settings from the plugin’s admin page.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin with WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce.

Can I enable or disable the top bar and close button?

Yes, you can easily enable or disable the top bar and its close button from the plugin settings without editing any code.

Is it possible to change the content dynamically?

Absolutely. The plugin lets you change top bar content dynamically from the admin panel, so you can update messages, announcements, or offers anytime.

Does the plugin support a countdown timer?

Yes. You can enable or disable the countdown timer feature. It’s useful for showing limited-time offers or upcoming events.

Can I set specific dates for my offers (day, month, year)?

Yes. The plugin allows you to select the exact day, month, and year for your top bar countdown.

Does the plugin support time zones?

Yes, you can configure the countdown timer with your preferred time zone, ensuring accurate timing for global users.

Can I customize the font and colors of the top bar?

Yes. You can set font size, choose a Google Font family via API, adjust font weight, and customize background and text colors dynamically.
sections.description:
Short Description

Create customizable top bars for your WordPress website with countdown timers, announcements, and promotional messages. Perfect for engaging visitors and boosting conversions.

This plugin provides an easy-to-use interface for adding promotional top bars with scheduling, WooCommerce compatibility, and custom styling options.

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses third-party/external services to enhance functionality. Below is detailed information about service:

Google Fonts
– API URL: https://www.googleapis.com/webfonts/v1/webfonts

  • Purpose: Google Fonts API is used to fetch and display web fonts for customization options in the plugin.

  • Data Sent: The plugin sends the Google Fonts API key to request a list of available fonts.

  • When Data is Sent: Data is transmitted only when customizing the plugin settings in the WordPress admin dashboard.

  • Privacy & Terms:

    • Google Fonts Privacy Policy
